searchText: MSRP $233,092. New 2027 Tiffin GH1 19FV Luxury Sprinter RV Features Solar Panel Lithium Batteries 15,000 A/C w/Heat Pump Starlink Prep Power Side Awning Induction Cooktop More About This RV Compact, capable, and built to disappear off the grid. The 2027 Tiffin GH1 19FV brings Tiffin craftsmanship to the trailhead in a nimble sub-20-foot package. Riding on the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter AWD chassis with a Fox shock system, custom off-road wheels, and BF Goodrich KO2 all-terrain tires, the GH1 handles washboard forest roads and city parking with equal ease. Inside, a compact galley with induction cooktop, stainless steel sink, and 12-volt refrigerator, plus a wet bath with cassette toilet, keeps you self-sufficient for days at a time. A lithium battery system paired with a inverter powers your appliances and electronics well past the last hookup, and finish details like Mercedes driver-assist technology remind you this is a Tiffin. Rugged where it counts and refined where it matters, the GH1 19FV is the adventure van for travelers who want to go small, go far, and stay out.
